role: Additional baseline amendment frozen before new test scoring; existing results and dev choices are preserved.
checkpoint_selection: typed-filtered dev MRR only; no test scoring until all model/source dev choices are locked

nodepiece.implementation: Official out-of-sample encoder and DistMult decoder; graph input and training loop adapted
nodepiece.anchor_strategy: degree on training message graph only

ingram.implementation: Official model and relation-graph construction; episodic train/message split

graph_input: Training facts and composition edges of training formulas; inference adds only the known compositions of formulas in the current eval partition. No held-out target or inverse enters message graphs. Same original entity IDs, splits and frozen candidate ranges as existing methods.
training_adaptations: No external pretraining for the main supervised comparison. Graph neural models use their native loss/architecture and recorded computational budgets, not claims of equal optimizer steps. Training target negatives exclude training truths only. Composition edges are message context, not extra target labels.
evaluation: Exact existing candidate-range-filtered tail ranking with average tie ranks; MRR, Hits@1/3/5/10, MR; all methods evaluate identical query order.
portability: If compiled rspmm is unavailable, call the official unfused message/aggregate/update with PyTorch scatter. Validate values and gradients on a tiny graph. Official source files stay unchanged.
main_result_policy: Retain all successfully evaluated requested baselines regardless of whether they outperform PairProto-KGE. Document failures or budget exhaustion; never substitute custom token encoders under official method names.
